Recommender Systems: Practice Problem

Podcasts: build the user’s vector, retrieve, and update with feedback

Son Nguyen

Practice Problem

Practice Problem: Build the User’s Vector, Then Retrieve

A podcast app gives every podcast a 2-number embedding (number 1: news and business, number 2: comedy and stories). These podcast embeddings were learned beforehand by the app’s model from all users’ listening data, so in this problem they are known. Only the user’s embedding must be computed.

Podcast Embedding (news, comedy)
Podcast A (0.8, 0.2)
Podcast B (0.2, 0.9)
Podcast C (0.6, 0.6)
Podcast D (0.1, 0.4)
Podcast E (0.9, 0.8)
Podcast F (0.1, 1.2)

Last month the user listened to Podcast E and Podcast F.

  1. Compute the user’s embedding as the average of the podcasts they listened to.

  2. Score every podcast with the dot product. Recommend the top 2 that the user has not heard.

Method: average-of-items user profile (Rocchio’s method; YouTube’s 2016 system started this way) + dot-product retrieval of the top K.

Caveat: on its own, this is a baseline, not what YouTube runs today. Big systems replace the plain average with a neural network (two-tower or transformer). The retrieval step after it (dot product, top K) is exactly what they still do.

Solution (a) and (b): The User’s Vector and Top 2 (Click to Step Through)

Podcast (news, comedy) Weight
A (0.8, 0.2)
B (0.2, 0.9)
C (0.6, 0.6)
D (0.1, 0.4)
E (0.9, 0.8) 1 (heard)
F (0.1, 1.2) 1 (heard)

The user = average of the 2 they heard:

\begin{aligned}\mathbf{u} &= \dfrac{(0.9, 0.8) + (0.1, 1.2)}{2} \\ &= \dfrac{(1.0,\ 2.0)}{2} = (0.5,\ 1)\end{aligned}

\text{score} = 0.5 \times \text{news} + 1 \times \text{comedy}

Podcast Calculation Score Rank
E 0.5(0.9) + 1(0.8) 1.25 heard: skip
F 0.5(0.1) + 1(1.2) 1.25 heard: skip
B 0.5(0.2) + 1(0.9) 1 #1 ✓
C 0.5(0.6) + 1(0.6) 0.9 #2 ✓
A 0.5(0.8) + 1(0.2) 0.6 #3
D 0.5(0.1) + 1(0.4) 0.45 #4

Recommend: B and C. (E and F score higher, but the user already heard them.)

Practice Problem, Round 2: One Week Later

New this week Embedding (also learned beforehand)
Podcast G (1.0, 0.5)
Podcast H (0.1, 1.0)
Podcast I (0.7, 0.9)

The user played Podcast C (one of our picks) and Podcast D (which we did not recommend); they skipped Podcast B. Three new podcasts (G, H, I) were also released this week.

  1. Recompute the user’s embedding as a weighted average of their 4 plays: older plays (E, F) count 1, this week’s plays (C, D) count 2. Score the 5 podcasts they have not heard (A, B, G, H, I) and recommend the top 2.

  2. The user also gave feedback: they liked Podcast D and tapped “not interested” on Podcast C. The app doubles the weight of a liked play and gives a “not interested” play weight −1. Recompute their embedding and their top 2.

Solution (c): Recent Plays Count More (Click to Step Through)

Podcast (news, comedy) Weight
A (0.8, 0.2)
B (0.2, 0.9)
C (0.6, 0.6) 2 (this week)
D (0.1, 0.4) 2 (this week)
E (0.9, 0.8) 1 (older)
F (0.1, 1.2) 1 (older)
G (1.0, 0.5) new
H (0.1, 1.0) new
I (0.7, 0.9) new

The user = weighted average. Weights: E ×1, F ×1, C ×2, D ×2; total = 6.

\begin{aligned}\mathbf{u} &= \dfrac{(0.9, 0.8) + (0.1, 1.2) + 2(0.6, 0.6) + 2(0.1, 0.4)}{6} \\ &= \dfrac{(2.4,\ 4.0)}{6} = (0.4,\ 0.667)\end{aligned}

\text{score} = 0.4 \times \text{news} + 0.667 \times \text{comedy}

Podcast Calculation Score Rank
E 0.4(0.9) + 0.667(0.8) 0.893 heard: skip
I 0.4(0.7) + 0.667(0.9) 0.88 #1 ✓
F 0.4(0.1) + 0.667(1.2) 0.84 heard: skip
G 0.4(1) + 0.667(0.5) 0.733 #2 ✓
H 0.4(0.1) + 0.667(1) 0.707 #3
B 0.4(0.2) + 0.667(0.9) 0.68 #4
C 0.4(0.6) + 0.667(0.6) 0.64 heard: skip
A 0.4(0.8) + 0.667(0.2) 0.453 #5
D 0.4(0.1) + 0.667(0.4) 0.307 heard: skip

Recommend: I and G. The user’s vector moved toward C and D, their newest plays.

Solution (d): Feedback Changes the Weights (Click to Step Through)

Podcast (news, comedy) Weight
A (0.8, 0.2)
B (0.2, 0.9)
C (0.6, 0.6) (−1) (not interested)
D (0.1, 0.4) 4 (this week, liked)
E (0.9, 0.8) 1 (older)
F (0.1, 1.2) 1 (older)
G (1.0, 0.5) new
H (0.1, 1.0) new
I (0.7, 0.9) new

The user = weighted average. Weights: E ×1, F ×1, C ×(−1), D ×4; total = 5.

\begin{aligned}\mathbf{u} &= \dfrac{(0.9, 0.8) + (0.1, 1.2) - (0.6, 0.6) + 4(0.1, 0.4)}{5} \\ &= \dfrac{(0.8,\ 3.0)}{5} = (0.16,\ 0.6)\end{aligned}

\text{score} = 0.16 \times \text{news} + 0.6 \times \text{comedy}

Podcast Calculation Score Rank
F 0.16(0.1) + 0.6(1.2) 0.736 heard: skip
I 0.16(0.7) + 0.6(0.9) 0.652 #1 ✓
E 0.16(0.9) + 0.6(0.8) 0.624 heard: skip
H 0.16(0.1) + 0.6(1) 0.616 #2 ✓
B 0.16(0.2) + 0.6(0.9) 0.572 #3
G 0.16(1) + 0.6(0.5) 0.46 #4
C 0.16(0.6) + 0.6(0.6) 0.456 heard: skip
D 0.16(0.1) + 0.6(0.4) 0.256 heard: skip
A 0.16(0.8) + 0.6(0.2) 0.248 #5

Recommend: I and H. Feedback swapped G (news) for H (stories): the user rejected C and liked D.
